长大了的袁承志.en: Horus, son of Isis and Osiris.
长大了的袁承志.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，伊西斯与奥西里斯的儿子。

龙游帮VIP服务小弟.en: A ferryman who also handles Dragon Guild travel.
龙游帮VIP服务小弟.zh-CN: 也承接游龙公会旅行服务的船夫。

prompt.zh-CN: 要把这份黄金据为己有吗？

prompt.en: Open the parcel, or keep it sealed for Isis?
prompt.zh-CN: 要打开包裹，还是保持封好留给伊西斯？
要支付这笔10,000银币的船资吗？

text.en: Horus, carry this. I recovered it from the thieves.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，拿着这个。我从窃贼那里追回来的。

text.en: Then we should find its owners, Mother.
text.zh-CN: 那我们该去找它的失主，母亲。

text.en: Of course. I asked you to carry a parcel, not settle a philosophical question.
text.zh-CN: 当然。我是让你拿个包裹，不是让你解决哲学难题。

text.en: (Horus keeps his arms folded. The parcel remains between them.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯依旧抱着胳膊。包裹还横在母子两人之间。）

text.en: If nobody wants it, I can give it a very comfortable home.
text.zh-CN: 要是谁都不想要，我倒能给它找个很舒服的家。

text.en: That's my mother, and that gold isn't yours.
text.zh-CN: 那是我母亲，而且这份黄金不是你的。

text.en: I asked for help carrying it, not a committee to spend it.
text.zh-CN: 我是请人帮着拿包裹，可不是请人商量怎么把它花光。

text.en: (Isis thrusts the parcel at you and strides ashore.)
text.zh-CN: （伊西斯把包裹塞给你，大步上了岸。）

text.en: (Horus starts after her. You step into his path.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯刚要跟上，你拦住了他的去路。）

text.en: Relax. I'm sure its owners won't miss a coin or two.
text.zh-CN: 别紧张。我想，失主总不至于计较一两枚金币。

text.en: You don't get to decide that. Hand it over.
text.zh-CN: 这不由你决定。把它交出来。

text.en: All right, Horus. Point taken. Let's sort this out without another duel.
text.zh-CN: 好吧，荷鲁斯。你的意思我明白了。剩下的，咱们别再靠决斗解决。

text.en: Then help me catch up with Mother.
text.zh-CN: 那就帮我追上母亲。

text.en: We'll look around Stonebridge Hall together. Keep that parcel sealed until we find her.
text.zh-CN: 我们一起去石桥会馆找找。在见到她之前，先别拆包裹。

text.en: Agreed. Take these supplies. I want witnesses when she asks what took so long.
text.zh-CN: 好。这些补给你先拿着。她问起我们为什么耽搁这么久，我还需要几个证人。

text.en: (Horus snatches back the parcel and hurries ashore after Isis.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯夺回包裹，匆匆上岸追赶伊西斯。）

text.en: Next time, I'm staying out of family finances. Stonebridge Hall it is.
text.zh-CN: 下次，我一定不掺和人家的家务账。先去石桥会馆吧。

text.en: Hold on. Your friends still owe their fares.
text.zh-CN: 等等。你朋友还欠着船资呢。

text.en: That sounds like a conversation you should have with my friends.
text.zh-CN: 这话，听起来应该跟我朋友说。

text.en: You arrived together. You can settle it together.
text.zh-CN: 一起来的，就一起结账。

text.en: Fine. What's the damage?
text.zh-CN: 好吧。一共多少？

text.en: 10,000 silver.
Horus? Family business?
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯？在商量家里的事？

text.en: My mother recovered some stolen gold. We're discussing where it goes.
text.zh-CN: 我母亲追回了一些赃金。我们在商量怎么处置。

text.en: Back to its owners, obviously. Both of you can stop looking so solemn.
text.zh-CN: 当然是还给失主。你们俩都不用这么严肃。

text.en: (Isis tucks the parcel under her arm and heads ashore.)
text.zh-CN: （伊西斯把包裹夹在臂下，径自上了岸。）

text.en: She walks fast.
text.zh-CN: 她走得可真快。

text.en: Always has. I should catch up before she starts another argument.
text.zh-CN: 一直如此。我得在她又跟人争论之前追上去。

text.en: She headed toward Stonebridge Hall. Does she always leave you to explain things?
text.zh-CN: 她往石桥会馆那边去了。她总把解释的事留给你吗？

text.en: Only when there are witnesses.
text.zh-CN: 只在有旁人看着的时候。

text.en: Then let's give you a few more. Come with us.
text.zh-CN: 那就再多几个旁人吧。和我们一起走。

text.en: Gladly. Take these supplies; we'll have better luck traveling together.
text.zh-CN: 好。这些补给你先拿着，我们结伴走会更顺当。

text.en: Gold... and a hairpin. I really should have left that sealed.
text.zh-CN: 黄金……还有一枚发簪。我真该把包裹好好封着。

text.en: Ten thousand? Did they charter the river? Fine. Here.
text.zh-CN: 一万？他们把整条河都包下来了？好吧，给你。

text.en: Thank you. Here's a Dragon Guild VIP Pass. Keep it if you come back.
text.zh-CN: 多谢。这是游龙公会贵宾证，下次来时记得带上。

text.en: Ten thousand silver? I was helping with a parcel, not chartering a fleet.
text.zh-CN: 一万银币？我只是帮着拿个包裹，可没包下整支船队。

text.en: Then settle the bill my way!
text.zh-CN: 那就照我的办法结账！

text.en: That was only the dock crew. Everyone else, over here!
text.zh-CN: 刚才只是码头的人。其他人，都过来！

text.en: Are we finished discussing the bill?
text.zh-CN: 这笔账，咱们谈完了吗？

text.en: (The ferryman studies the planks at his feet.)
text.zh-CN: （船夫低头研究起脚下的木板。）

text.en: And what's this?
text.zh-CN: 这又是什么？

text.en: A Dragon Guild VIP Pass. Let's call this a receipt.
text.zh-CN: 游龙公会贵宾证。那就当作收据吧。

text.en: (The ferryman looks as though he'd rather close the ferry for the day.)
text.zh-CN: （船夫看起来很想今天就此收船。）
